# 平衡是计数的全部规律：每组跨步保持、不再成立与开始成立的计数都由一个队列实现；缺平衡或缺体现的前提不约束计数；全部八个前提之下，计数的规律恰是平衡与没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起 / The balance is the whole law of counting: every tally of members kept, ceasing and coming is counted by a queue; premises lacking balance or embodiment leave counting free; under all eight premises the laws of counting are the balance and that nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active

## 主张 Claim

一个规定每步的成立者被不重复地列出（Listed）且可判定时，跨每一步保持一些成员：它们连同跨步不再成立的成员是步前的列表，连同跨步开始成立的成员是步后的列表（Listed.keeps；普查的平衡 Listed.across 由此推出）。称每步的数目 n、跨步不再成立的数目 c 与开始成立的数目 a 为计数表（Tally），若每步有某数 k 使 n t = k + c t 且 n (t+1) = k + a t；每个列出的计数都是计数表（Listed.tally）。反过来，每个计数表都由一个队列实现：自然数作为成员，第 t 步在队中的是从此前离开的总数起的 n t 个，从队尾加入、从队首离开，各依其次（Queue.holds、Queue.line）；它被不重复地列出（Queue.listed），每步列出 n t 个，跨步离开 c t 个、加入 a t 个（Queue.counts）。所以对计数的一个性质（只要求尊重每步的值，Pointwise），在每个类型上每个列出的计数都满足它，恰当每个计数表都满足它（counting_laws）：计数没有平衡之外的规律。读于世界的活动：成员排队而什么都不流动的世界满足除体现外的全部前提（活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用其所汲取的、耗散、普查、有界传递；World.queue_premised），成员排队且恰在活跃时立着的世界满足除平衡外的全部前提（World.embodiedQueue_premised）；所以对计数的一个性质在每个世界的每个普查中成立，恰当它对每个计数表成立，也恰当它在满足除体现外全部前提的每个世界中成立，也恰当它在满足除平衡外全部前提的每个世界中成立（World.counting_free）：缺平衡或缺体现的前提不约束计数。两者连同只有活跃者给予一起约束：在平衡、只有活跃者给予且生起者体现的世界中，生起者由一个在该步活跃的关系项给予（Web.Embodied.arises_given），所以普查之下，没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起；而一个关系项从无到有地生起（Queue.lone_tally）是计数表，由两个队列世界实现，所以这不是计数的规律（World.counting_binds_jointly）。八个前提所加的只有这一条：由队首照管的队列，队首给予每个加入者一个单位、从每个离开者取用一个单位，活跃时与每个地关系项各交换一个单位（World.tendedQueue），在没有成员加入空队的每个计数表之下满足全部八个前提（World.tendedQueue_premised；队首活跃的步上没有有限家族封闭，所以耗散在那里空成立，队空的步上什么都不交换）；所以对计数的一个性质在满足全部八个前提的每个世界的普查中成立，恰当它对每个没有关系项活跃的一步上没有生起的计数表成立（World.premised_counting）。被围住时不然：从某步起每步被围住所立者时，静止定理使生起与止息都不再复现。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once (Listed), and the determination is decided, across each step some members are kept: with the members ceasing to be across it they are the list before the step, and with the members coming to be the list after it (Listed.keeps; the census balance Listed.across follows from it). Call counts n at each step, c ceasing and a coming across it a tally (Tally) when at each step some number k has n t = k + c t and n (t + 1) = k + a t; the counts of every listing are a tally (Listed.tally). Conversely every tally is counted by a queue: with natural numbers as members, at step t the queue holds n t members from the number that have left before, members joining at the back and leaving from the front, each in turn (Queue.holds, Queue.line); it is listed, each member once (Queue.listed), with n t listed at each step, c t leaving and a t joining across it (Queue.counts). So a property of the counts, asked only to respect their values at each step (Pointwise), holds of the counts of every listing on every type exactly when it holds of every tally (counting_laws): counting has no law beyond the balance. Read of the activity of worlds: relata queuing with nothing flowing meet every premise but embodiment (activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking what they draw on, dissipation, a census, bounded transmission; World.queue_premised), and relata queuing that stand exactly while active meet every premise but balance (World.embodiedQueue_premised); so a property of the counts holds of every census of every world exactly when it holds of every tally, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but embodiment, and exactly when it holds in every world meeting every premise but balance (World.counting_free): premises lacking balance or embodiment leave counting free. With only active relata giving, the two bind it together: in a world whose flow balances, in which only active relata give and whatever arises is embodied, what arises is given by a relatum active at the step (Web.Embodied.arises_given), so under a census nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active; one relatum arising from none (Queue.lone_tally) is a tally, counted by both queue worlds, so this is no law of counting (World.counting_binds_jointly). That is all the eight premises add: a queue tended by its front, which gives one unit to each relatum joining, takes one from each leaving and, while active, exchanges a unit each way with every ground relatum (World.tendedQueue), meets all eight premises under every tally in which nothing joins an empty queue (World.tendedQueue_premised; no finite family is closed at a step at which the front is active, so dissipation holds there vacuously, and nothing is exchanged at a step at which the queue is empty); so a property of the counts holds of the census of every world meeting all eight exactly when it holds of every tally in which nothing arises across a step at which nothing is active (World.premised_counting). Enclosure is different: with every step from some step on enclosed around what stands, the rest theorem stops arising and ceasing. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 列出与可判定：同 census-balance；读于世界时是活动可判定。这是表示的逻辑承诺。 / Listing and decidability: as in census-balance; read of worlds, decided activity. It is a logical commitment of the representation.
- 逐点（Pointwise）：性质尊重计数每步的值。有函数外延性时每个性质都如此；纯净核心不假设它，所以作为定理的假设陈述。 / Pointwise: the property respects the counts' values at each step. With function extensionality every property does; the pure core does not assume it, so it is a hypothesis of the theorems.

完整的陈述（P23）说，整体的规律除了表示本身所排除的，不排除任何展开。对计数，本结果使这一点精确：平衡不排除任何计数表，所以从计数本身推不出关于展开的任何更多的东西。开放纲领中的“对整个空间成立的规律的完整清单”在计数的部分由此给出。前提的地图（map-of-premises）表明八个前提彼此独立；本结果说明它们中的哪些约束计数：缺平衡或缺体现的任何一组都不约束，两者连同只有活跃者给予一起约束，而全部八个所加的也只有这一条；更多的约束来自被围住：静止定理（ceasing-needs-arising、continued-change-needs-openness）在被围住之下使计数归于静止。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在场者的数目只记录进入与离开相抵；展开怎样改变这些数目，来自给予与取用的关系，即平衡与体现一起所说的：生起需要一个在场的给予者。这是活动的计数，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名），不是 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”，也不评价生起或止息。 / The full statement (P23) says that the laws of the whole exclude no unfolding beyond what the representation itself excludes. For counting this result makes it precise: the balance excludes no tally, so nothing more about an unfolding follows from counting alone. The open programme's ‘complete list of the laws holding of the whole space’ is thereby given for counting. The map of premises (map-of-premises) shows the eight premises independent; this result says which of them constrain counting: no set lacking balance or embodiment does, the two together with only active relata giving do, and all eight add nothing more; further constraint comes from enclosure: under it the rest theorem (ceasing-needs-arising, continued-change-needs-openness) brings counting to rest. The author's reading (an AI argument): the number present records only that entering and leaving balance; how an unfolding changes these numbers comes from the relations of giving and taking, which is what balance and embodiment say together: arising needs a giver present. This is the counting of activity, whose English names arising and ceasing Ren confirmed (the Chinese 生起／止息 being the AI's rendering); it is not the proposal's generative and degenerative, and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

只对离散步与每步有限的成立者陈述；要求可判定（逻辑承诺）与逐点（代替函数外延性）；只说计数，不说哪个成员进入或离开，也不说关系；队列世界的关系项无限多，每个只生起一次；有限世界中计数还受关系项的数目所限，那里计数的规律没有陈述；读于世界只陈述了活动的计数，水平与依存的计数由一般的 counting_laws 给出，在前提之下没有陈述；全部八个前提之下计数的规律已给出，加上被围住时（静止定理之外）计数的规律没有陈述；队首照管的队列中耗散在队首活跃的步上空成立；不评价生起或止息；名称（Tally、Queue、Pointwise、CountsObey、tendedQueue 等）是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定。 / Stated for discrete steps and holders finitely many at each step; needs decidability (a logical commitment) and pointwise properties (in place of function extensionality); speaks only of counts, saying neither which member enters or leaves nor anything of relations; the queue worlds have infinitely many relata, each arising once; in a finite world the counts are further bounded by the number of relata, and the laws of counting there are not stated; read of worlds only the counting of activity is stated, the counts of standing and dependence being covered by the general counting_laws and not stated under the premises; the laws of counting under all eight premises are given, but with enclosure added, beyond the rest theorem, they are not stated; in the tended queue dissipation holds vacuously at steps at which the front is active; evaluates neither arising nor ceasing; the names (Tally, Queue, Pointwise, CountsObey, tendedQueue and others) are the AI's wording, for Ren to choose.
